content: <1>Files ({{filesCount}})</1> and <1>folders ({{foldersCount}})</1> will be moved to Trash, where you can restore them for 30 days. After that, they're permanently deleted.

comment.text: Body text of the Move to Trash? confirmation dialog shown when a user deletes a mix of files and folders. {{filesCount}} and {{foldersCount}} are numbers, each <1></1> pair is bold; Trash is the name of the Trash section; the items stay restorable for 30 days.
